original.reason: Disjointness of U and V does not imply that their alpha-coordinate projections are disjoint; points in the two projections can arise from different choices of the other coordinates. Thus the asserted separating open sets need not be disjoint.

judgment.reason: The fixed-coordinate section is a homeomorphism onto a subspace of the Hausdorff product, so the factor is Hausdorff.
It correctly verifies the section and restricted projection are continuous inverses and uses heredity of Hausdorffness to subspaces.
The displayed fixed-coordinate subspace is homeomorphic to X_alpha and is Hausdorff as a subspace.
It establishes only that the inverse projection is continuous; it does not establish continuity of s, which is needed to conclude that s is a homeomorphism.
